description: Cited reference facts, thresholds, and classifications used across the system. These are established lookups (not simulations) — the LLM orchestrator uses them to ground answers instead of recalling facts from memory. Extend this file to broaden coverage cheaply (no new module needed).

legal_bac_limit_driving_us.citation: US per se DUI limit (NHTSA; all states except Utah 0.05)
legal_bac_limit_driving_us.notes: Commercial drivers 0.04; under-21 zero-tolerance (~0.00-0.02). Many countries use 0.05. This is a legal threshold, not a safety guarantee — impairment starts below it.

bmi_categories.notes: Adult classification only. Not valid under 18y (use pediatric BMI-for-age percentiles) or for high-muscle athletes.

healthy_bmi_range.notes: Used to derive a healthy weight range for a given height.
